name: Rendered Spores
summary: Across the Barrens, Rendered Spores are being rushed from Apothecary Helbrim to Thunder Bluff before they decay. Apothecary Zamah must stabilize the emulsion beneath the city.

sections.title: A Volatile Mixture
sections.body: Apothecary Helbrim makes Rendered Spores from fungal spores gathered near the Barrens’ damp oases. He processes the strange spores into an active chemical emulsion, but it is unstable. After forty-five minutes, it breaks down and becomes useless for scientific study.

sections.title: Delivery to the Pools of Vision
sections.body: Apothecary Helbrim cannot finish refining the emulsion at his remote outpost. It must reach his Forsaken colleague, Apothecary Zamah, beneath Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff. In the Pools of Vision, Zamah has the equipment and reagents to reseal and finish processing the spores for the Royal Apothecary Society.

faq.q: What are Rendered Spores used for?
aliases: what does zamah do with spores
faq.answer: Apothecary Helbrim turns fungal matter into an emulsion for the Royal Apothecary Society to study. In Thunder Bluff, Apothecary Zamah uses it to continue investigating the strange growths spreading across the Barrens.

faq.q: Why does the emulsion have a time limit?
faq.answer: The emulsion Apothecary Helbrim makes is volatile and starts to decay as soon as it is mixed. Its active potency lasts only forty-five minutes, so it must be carried across the plains to Thunder Bluff before it becomes inert.
Apothecary Helbrim, a Forsaken researcher at the Crossroads in the Barrens, turns raw fungal spores gathered near the oases into an unstable liquid compound.

faq.q: Where does the mixture need to go?
faq.answer: The mixture must reach Apothecary Zamah, who lives in the Pools of Vision beneath Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff, the tauren capital.

angles.text: As an undead, you are part of a people whose Royal Apothecary Society seeks biological compounds across Kalimdor to aid the Forsaken. Fast couriers link field researchers like Helbrim with specialists like Zamah.
As a tauren, you see Forsaken apothecaries experimenting on strange Barrens flora inside the sacred Pools of Vision. Their work reflects the uneasy, practical alliance forged within Thunder Bluff.
